admin.title: GitHub Issue from Post
admin.description: Send post content to a new GitHub issue from the post options menu.
admin.repo-help: Target repository in owner/repository format, e.g. NodeBB/NodeBB
admin.labels-help: Optional comma-separated labels added to every created issue. If the token's account has no push access to the repository, GitHub ignores labels sent over the API — in that case add the forum-labels workflow from the plugin's README to the repository and the labels will be applied by the repository itself.
admin.token-help: Personal access token with permission to create issues. Write-only: it cannot be viewed after saving. Leave empty to keep the current token.
admin.expiry-help: Number of days the token is valid from the moment it is saved. Leave empty for no expiry. Administrators are notified 10 days before expiry and again when it expires.
admin.status-not-set: No token is configured — the button is hidden from all users until a token and repository are set.
admin.status-expired: The token expired on %1 — creating issues is blocked until a new token is saved.
admin.public-sidebar: Make the open issues sidebar visible to everyone
admin.public-sidebar-help: The topic issues sidebar will be visible to all logged-in users, rather than only users with the issue creation privilege.
admin.privilege-help: Who can use the button is controlled by the regular privileges system: under Manage → Privileges select "Global Privileges", click the "Other" filter, and grant the "Open GitHub issue from post" privilege to groups or individual users.
admin.notifications-help: The author of the post an issue was opened from is notified about the events selected here. An author who no longer has read access to the post is skipped.
admin.notify-closed: Issue closed (including the reason: completed, not planned or duplicate)
admin.merge-seconds-help: Several actions on the same issue in quick succession arrive as a single notification. Updates are held for this long before being sent, and anything that still arrives separately is merged again while it is unread. Default is 60 seconds; 0 sends every update on its own.
admin.webhook-help: The fastest and cheapest way to receive updates. In the repository, under Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook, set the payload URL below, choose the content type application/json, paste the same secret, and subscribe to the "Issues" and "Issue comments" events.
admin.webhook-url-help: Enter this address in the repository's webhook settings. GitHub must be able to reach it, so the forum has to be publicly accessible.
admin.webhook-secret-help: A shared secret used to sign deliveries. Write-only: it cannot be viewed after saving. Leave empty to keep the current secret. Without a secret, deliveries are rejected.
admin.webhook-secret-not-set: No webhook secret is configured — incoming deliveries are rejected.
admin.poll-help: An alternative to the webhook for forums that GitHub cannot reach. The plugin periodically asks GitHub what changed. It detects closing, reopening, renaming and new comments, but not label, assignee or milestone changes. Both channels can run together: an event is never notified about twice.
admin.poll-minutes-help: How often to query GitHub. Default is 5 minutes. The token needs read access to issues.
